rationale: X has a richer hero illustration with a specific survey data card, illustrated feature cards that each carry their own scene, and a more distinctive gold and teal palette. Y is clean and coherent but its feature icons are tiny and generic, the visual is a simpler landscape with two floating chips, and the overall layout reads closer to a standard SaaS template. X is the one a design director would ship, though it has some hero card overlap and a cropped partner strip at the fold.
